newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila sets date for Yankee underwriting rebid.
newsitem.headline: Manila sets date for Yankee underwriting rebid.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said it has scheduled the bidding for the firm underwriting contract of its maiden Yankee bond issue on June 17.
Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson told reporters late on Friday evening that the bank still has the right to reject the bids if the spreads quoted were deemed unacceptable.
The bank decided on Thursday to revamp the underwriting structure, which was initially given on a best effort basis, after receiving firm offers from the syndicate members.
Six international investment banks are expected to join the auction where the winning bid will be based on the lowest "blended rate" for the 30-year and 100-year bonds, Singson said.
The blended rate is the weighted average coupon to be given to both the 30-year and 100-year bonds.
The six interested banks are Salomon Brothers with JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, ING Barings, Citicorp and Merrill Lynch.
Singson said the offer size would be lower than the original $750 million of which 80 percent will carry 30 year maturity and the remaining 20 percent, 100 years.

The Central Bank postponed its first Yankee issue in mid-April hours before the formal launch after it was told that investors were buying the bonds for 230 basis points above the prevailing U.S. Treasury bond rate of 7.18 percent.
The bank was then willing to go as high as 205 basis points.
At present, Singson said the prevailing T-bond yield has dropped to 6.71 percent. "Naturally, we expect the spreads to be lower than what was mentioned in April," he said.
Singson added the prevailing interest rate condition presented a favourable timing for the bank to relaunch its Yankee bond.
The announcement of the winning bidder will depend on how soon the Bank auction committee can make its decision, Singson said.
He said the entire proceeds of the bond will be turned over to the bank within ten days after the announcement of the winning underwriter.
